book_note: The standings themselves, entry by entry, are on the Promoted Book page. This page does not grade anything: it only reports how the standings the program recorded change from one grading to the next.

gradings.detail: The book was graded once, in one act, from two searches run that same day: the first search (started 6:06 in the morning, counting 15,135 combinations for testing across the years from its January 1, 2023 split) and the second search (started 4:34 in the afternoon, counting 21,345 combinations for testing across the years from its July 1, 2025 split). The two searches are two sets of years graded on one day, not two gradings of the book over time.

movements_note: No entry has been re-graded yet. proving_state: A measuring tool, nothing to prove
proving_words: The tool only reports, filters, calculates or counts from records on file; it makes no forecast claim of its own, so there is nothing to grade.
source: Our own forecast program's book of promoted entries, frozen as the program recorded it, and the two search records from the day the book was graded
watch_note: The watch starts from the grading of Tuesday, October 27, 2026. When the program grades the book again, this page will show each entry whose standing changed, with the standing it had, the standing it has, and the two grading dates, plus the counts of promotions, demotions, and probation entries and exits that the new grading records. Until a second grading exists, there is no movement to show, and none is invented here.
